audience: researchers, clinicians and librarians who search biomedical literature in PubMed

useCases.title: Search recent articles on a topic
useCases.text: Run a PubMed search with the same syntax as the search box, then read the titles, authors, journal and dates of the hits.

useCases.title: Build a reference list with abstracts
useCases.text: Fetch the citation and abstract of up to 20 PMIDs. Keep the PMID and journal of each article for citing.

useCases.title: Find articles similar to a paper
useCases.text: List the similar articles of one PMID, then read their titles and dates.

useCases.title: Count publications on a topic
useCases.text: Search with a date range and read the total hit count, for example the records on one drug in one year.

useCases.title: Find the right search field codes
useCases.text: Read PubMed's record count, last update time and the field codes, such as TIAB or AU, that the search accepts.
